causality_contract.availability_rule: 60m CVD slope + price slope use data <= bar close; displacement confirmation <= close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored

direction: divergence-implied reversal (bullish: price lower-low + CVD higher-low; bearish mirror)

entry.rule: signal at 1m bar close; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = signal bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: Bullish: 1m close makes a 60-bar lowest low while 60m CVD slope (last-minus-first over trailing 60m) is positive, plus bullish 1m displacement within 5 bars. Bearish mirror with signs flipped.
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence, pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0 falsifies (FAIL).
invalidation: Displacement fails within 5 bars, or CVD slope flips sign before entry.
mechanism: Falling price on rising cumulative aggressor flow indicates absorption of selling / latent demand; displacement confirms acceptance.
negative_controls: momentum alignment (price+CVD same sign; expect null)
research_question: Does CVD-vs-price divergence plus structural confirmation predict reversal?

stop.reference: 60m swing extreme that printed the price low/high

threshold_provenance: 60m slope window = one hour of microstructure context (domain convention, fixed). Displacement 2xATR = certified. Slope signs are structural (no magnitude threshold to tune).
